title: Save an agent-read dataset
description: The last detection tier (failure-endpoint fallback D4): save records you read yourself from the page with dsagent.page.observe / dsagent.page.find / dsagent.page.markdown as a dataset, after the scrape wizard on that page ended on a typed detection failure.
guidance: Use it only when auto detection, detect-with-ai and pick-sample-record have all failed: cite the wizard (wizardId, wizardToken), the typed endpoint it ended on (endpoint = dsagent.wizard.state lastEndpoint.endpoint, e.g. structure-none or ai-found-nothing, admitted only when lastEndpoint.agentReadAdmissible is true) and pageContextId of the page you read (the page of that wizard, or a sample page it opened). When dsagent.wizard.start refused the page itself (details.endpoint page-not-scrapable or session-start-refused with details.agentReadAdmissible true), cite its details.refusalId as wizardId and that endpoint instead: the refusal is the typed detection failure for that page. Never for a sign-in or verification wall: that waits for the person. Records are flat objects of page values (string, number, boolean or null); the Extension normalises field names, drops credential and payment fields, redacts credential-shaped values and enforces the size limits. The dataset is labelled source agent-read, replayable false, with its coverage (recordsSaved counted by the Extension; expectedRecords, pagesVisited and stoppedBecause as you state them): report it as agent-read, never as a workflow result. It creates or updates no workflow and cannot be run again. One save holds at most 500 records; save more to the same capture with captureId and the captureToken the first save returned. Read the dataset back with dsagent.artifacts.list (executionId = captureId) and dsagent.artifact.read, or export it with dsagent.execution.data.export. Requires an idempotency key; repeating a key with the same input returns the same result.

inputSchema.description: A first save cites the wizard failure and the page; an append cites the capture instead.

wizardId.description: First save: the scrape wizard (dsagent.wizard.start) that ended on a typed detection failure; or, when dsagent.wizard.start itself refused the page (a browser, file, PDF or non-HTTP page: TARGET_NOT_FOUND / OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with details.refusalId and details.endpoint page-not-scrapable or session-start-refused), that refusalId.

wizardToken.description: First save: the wizard token dsagent.wizard.start returned; it proves the wizard is yours after a connection renewal.

endpoint.description: First save: the typed detection endpoint the wizard ended on, exactly as dsagent.wizard.state reports it (lastEndpoint.endpoint); its lastEndpoint.agentReadAdmissible must be true.

pageContextId.description: First save: the page the records were read on (the wizard's page or a sample page it opened), from dsagent.page.observe.

captureId.description: Append: the captureId an earlier save returned.

captureToken.description: Append: the captureToken the capture's first save returned.

name.description: First save: the dataset name the person sees (normalised, at most 120 characters); a dated default when omitted.

fields.description: Optional field order: these names first, then other record keys as first seen.

records.description: The records read from the page, one object per record, field name to value; only values the page shows.

items.description: One record: field name to a page value.

additionalProperties.description: A value exactly as the page shows it.

coverage.description: What was read: an honest statement, shown with the dataset.

expectedRecords.description: How many records the page says exist (its result count), when it says so.

pagesVisited.description: Pages (list pages, scroll loads, detail pages) the records were read from, as the agent stated.

stoppedBecause.description: Why reading stopped: end-of-data, requested-count-reached, page-limit, time-limit, page-blocked, agent-limit; reading = more saves to this capture follow.

outputSchema.description: The saved capture and its label.

captureId.description: The capture: pass it as executionId to dsagent.artifacts.list or dsagent.execution.data.export, and with captureToken to append.

captureToken.description: Returned by the first save only: keep it to append to this capture.

datasetName.description: The dataset name the person sees.

columns.description: The normalised field names of this save, in order.

droppedFields.description: Fields left out because their name says they hold a credential or payment secret.

redactedValues.description: Values whose credential-shaped parts were replaced by [redacted].

source.description: The records were read by the agent, not by a workflow.

replayable.description: Always false: no workflow can collect this dataset again.

recordsSaved.description: Records the dataset holds now, counted by the Extension after the write committed (identical records count once).

expectedRecords.description: How many records the page says exist (its result count), when it says so.

pagesVisited.description: Pages (list pages, scroll loads, detail pages) the records were read from, as the agent stated.

stoppedBecause.description: Why reading stopped: end-of-data, requested-count-reached, page-limit, time-limit, page-blocked, agent-limit; reading = more saves to this capture follow.

admittedBy.description: The detection failure that admitted the capture.

wizardId.description: The wizard that failed, or the refused wizard start (its refusalId).

savedAt.description: When the label was last written (ISO 8601).
